verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at motherduck.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and the docs also publish an llms-full.txt. Many documentation pages are served as agent-friendly markdown (.md) URLs, so an agent can be pointed at either the index or individual pages. missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents using these docs, and consistent markdown availability (the probe of /docs/getting-started/.md returned 404).
